content.title: About
content.content: Similac Advance Ready-to-Feed is a infant formula designed for babies from birth to 12 months. It contains whole cow’s milk, fermented lactose, prebiotics, DHA, ARA, and a full spectrum of vitamins and minerals needed for growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Similac Advance is manufactured by Abbott, one of the world’s largest infant nutrition companies.
The formula is enriched with DHA and ARA – fatty acids that support brain and eye development.
It includes prebiotics (PDX and GOS) to promote a healthy gut microbiome.
Ready-to-Feed format requires no mixing with water, making it convenient for travel and situations without clean water.
The product has undergone clinical testing and meets the recommendations of the American Academy of Pediatrics.

items.title: Bone growth support
items.content: Contains calcium, phosphorus and vitamin D, which together help build strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Brain and eye development
items.content: DHA and ARA are structural components of brain tissue and retinal cells, supporting their normal development.

items.title: Healthy gut flora
items.content: Prebiotics PDX and GOS stimulate the growth of beneficial bacteria, improving digestion and immunity.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: A balanced mix of protein, fat and carbohydrates provides a steady source of energy for rapid growth.

items.title: Vitamin‑mineral complex
items.content: B‑vitamins, vitamin C, iron and zinc support immune function and metabolic processes.

items.title: Cow‑milk allergy
items.content: Infants with a confirmed cow‑milk protein allergy may react to this formula and should not use it.

items.title: Lactose content
items.content: Babies with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort; a lactose‑free formula should be chosen instead.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Once opened, the product should be refrigerated at +2–4 °C and used within 48 hours.

items.title: Not a complete substitute for breast milk
items.content: While nutritionally complete, breast milk remains the preferred source of nutrition during the first six months.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve the ready‑to‑feed formula directly from the container, warming gently to body temperature if desired (no more than 37 °C). Do not microwave, as it can create hot spots.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 48 hours. Discard if the product develops an off‑smell, color change, or unusual taste.
